content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To buy tickets to the zoo, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Choose which animal encounter to add to the ticket (15 minutes)
Step 2. Research different membership tier benefits (1 hour)
Step 3. Print the final confirmation receipt (2 minutes)
Step 4. Create a secure login on the zoo website (10 minutes)
Step 5. Select the number of adult and child tickets (5 minutes)
Step 6. Check the weather forecast for the visit date (5 minutes)
Step 7. Decide on a budget for the zoo outing (30 minutes)
Step 8. Enter the promotional discount code (2 minutes)
Step 9. Search for third-party coupon sites (20 minutes)
Step 10. Review the zoo's safety and conduct policy (15 minutes)
Step 11. Select the specific date for the visit (5 minutes)
Step 12. Check for parking pass availability (5 minutes)
Step 13. Confirm the final total in the shopping cart (2 minutes)
Step 14. Input the primary visitor's contact information (5 minutes)
Step 15. Verify the billing address matches the card (3 minutes)
Step 16. Agree to the terms and conditions (1 minute)
Step 17. Locate the official zoo ticket portal (5 minutes)
Step 18. Set aside funds in a digital wallet (10 minutes)
Step 19. Check the zoo's closing time for that day (2 minutes)
Step 20. Consult with family on the preferred arrival time (20 minutes)
Step 21. Select the entry time slot (5 minutes)
Step 22. Compare weekend vs. weekday pricing (15 minutes)
Step 23. Look for "bundle" deals including lunch (10 minutes)
Step 24. Clear browser cookies to ensure fresh pricing (2 minutes)
Step 25. Select the preferred payment method (2 minutes)
Step 26. Read reviews of the special exhibits (30 minutes)
Step 27. Check the schedule for live animal shows (15 minutes)
Step 28. Sign up for the zoo's email newsletter (5 minutes)
Step 29. Check for student or senior discounts (5 minutes)
Step 30. Determine if a guided tour is needed (15 minutes)
Step 31. Opt-in or out of a conservation donation (1 minute)
Step 32. Verify the zoo's current operating hours (5 minutes)
Step 33. Coordinate transportation to the zoo (45 minutes)
Step 34. Double-check the selected ticket quantities (2 minutes)
Step 35. Finalize the ticket selection in the portal (2 minutes)
Step 36. Choose a digital or physical ticket delivery (2 minutes)
Step 37. Calculate the total cost including taxes (5 minutes)
Step 38. Map out the route to the zoo entrance (10 minutes)
Step 39. Decide between a day pass or an annual membership (20 minutes)
Step 40. Review the "items not allowed" list (10 minutes)
Step 41. Ask friends for a referral link (1 hour)
Step 42. Verify the availability of strollers for rent (5 minutes)
Step 43. Enter the credit card details (5 minutes)
Step 44. Check the age requirements for certain exhibits (10 minutes)
Step 45. Read the refund and cancellation policy (15 minutes)
Step 46. Ensure the internet connection is stable (1 minute)
Step 47. Check for group rate requirements (15 minutes)
Step 48. Receive a temporary booking reference (1 minute)
Step 49. Check if the zoo café requires reservations (10 minutes)
Step 50. Select the "e-ticket" delivery method (1 minute)
Step 51. Solve the CAPTCHA on the checkout page (30 seconds)
Step 52. Review the final order summary (2 minutes)
Step 53. Confirm the email address for ticket delivery (1 minute)
Step 54. Check the device's battery level (1 minute)
Step 55. Add a souvenir photo package (5 minutes)
Step 56. Look for regional residency discounts (20 minutes)
Step 57. Submit the payment for processing (30 seconds)
Step 58. Take a screenshot of the transaction ID (30 seconds)
Step 59. Create a backup of the login credentials (5 minutes)
Step 60. Check the accessibility features of the zoo (15 minutes)
Step 61. Close unnecessary browser tabs (1 minute)
Step 62. Verify the zoo's location on the map (5 minutes)
Step 63. Update the browser to the latest version (10 minutes)
Step 64. Check for any "closed for maintenance" alerts (5 minutes)
Step 65. Look for a "lost and found" policy (5 minutes)
Step 66. Check for military or first responder discounts (10 minutes)
Step 67. Download the zoo's mobile app (3 minutes)
Step 68. Wait for the payment authorization (1 minute)
Step 69. Receive the tickets via email (5 minutes)
Step 70. Confirm the ticket barcodes are legible (2 minutes)
